title: Validate and normalize email on registration
body:
## Summary

Registration now checks the email format and stores emails in lowercase.

## Changes

* Regex email check
* trim and lowercase before saving

## How to test

Register with Bob@Shop.com then log in.

verixa_should_cover: Invalid formats such as a@b or spaces are rejected
Registering the same email in different case returns 409
Login with the original mixed case email must work (BUG: login does not normalize)
